data.title: Colors — Beginner · Lesson 2
data.subject: colors
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
Pack the car, grab the map, we’re hitting the road.
Spanish lessons with the crew, everybody knows.

[Hook]
White… Blanco
Pink… Rosa
Orange… Naranja
Colors shining as we go.
Red… Rojo
Blue… Azul
Let’s sing loud… Cantemos fuerte
Under the sky so blue.

[Verse]
Windows down, we’re cruising by,
Feel the wind, the sun so high.
Yellow… Amarillo
Fields of gold, can’t you see?
Green… Verde
Trees are waving, wild and free.
Turn it up, let’s make a scene,
With the colors of the day.

[Hook]
White… Blanco
Pink… Rosa
Orange… Naranja
Colors shining as we go.
Red… Rojo
Blue… Azul
Let’s sing loud… Cantemos fuerte
Under the sky so blue.

[Verse]
Stop for snacks, a little break,
Laugh and talk, what’s at stake?
Purple… Morado
Grapes are sweet, taste the flavor.
Brown… Marrón
Coffee in hand, we savor.
Every mile, a new surprise,
With the colors of the skies.

[Bridge]
Hey, hey, hey… Let’s keep the pace.
Feel the rhythm, feel the bass.
Colors everywhere we look,
